notes.title: Infected – Full Release is Here! 🎮
notes.notes:
[h1]Survivors, the wait is over! Infected has officially reached its final release and is now available for download on Steam!
Get ready to step into a harsh post-apocalyptic world where a deadly virus has transformed much of the population into terrifying infected zombies. You'll need every ounce of your skill, strategy, and firepower to survive.[/h1]

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that our new game "Infected" is now available in Early Access on Steam! Get ready to experience an action-packed survival game like never before. To celebrate the release, we are offering a special launch discount of 20% on all purchases made before April 25th, 2023.
 In Infected, you will find yourself stranded in a post-apocalyptic world where a deadly virus has turned most of the population into zombie-like creatures. Your mission is to survive against all odds, and you will need to scavenge for resources, and fight off hordes of infected and other human enemies.
 Don't miss out on this thrilling adventure! Head over to our Steam page and get your copy of Infected today while the discount lasts. We can't wait to see you in the game!
